# Third-party resources

- **EmDash blog template** — Copyright 2026 Cloudflare Inc. The upstream MIT notice is preserved in [LICENSES/Cloudflare-MIT.txt](../../LICENSES/Cloudflare-MIT.txt).
- **WordPressGit** — The theme credits 云落 and identifies yusi as its base. Its stylesheet declares GPL v2 or later. The supplied [GPL v2 text](wordpressgit-LICENSE) is preserved. The EmDash stylesheet adapts its visual design. The fortune corpus in `src/theme/fortunes.json` was taken from the theme bundle. [Upstream theme](https://coding.net/u/googlo/p/Git/git)
- **Assets and share scripts from the WordPressGit bundle** — https://github.com/BennyThink/WordPressGit  `public/theme/avatars/`, `public/images/fallback/`, `public/theme/footbg.jpg` and `public/theme/needsharebutton.min.*`. The bundle is the known source for these files. The original creators and separate redistribution terms have not been verified.
- **pangu.js 3.3.0** — Vinta Chen, MIT. The original license notice is preserved in `src/theme/pangu.js`, which adapts the bundled script for use as an ES module. [Upstream project](https://github.com/vinta/pangu.js)
- **T-Rex Runner** — From the WordPressGit bundle, originally extracted from Chromium's offline page. See the bundled [LICENSE](../theme/t-rex-runner/LICENSE) and [NOTICE](../theme/t-rex-runner/NOTICE).
